title: 第19章 蒸汽工厂第20章 巴克大师
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：“话说……那个往下的通道是通向哪里？”
和蒂芙尼一起走出厨房后，琉璃川千代伸出手，指向了一个有着两位重甲骑士守在门口的偏僻楼梯口。
她们现在处在一楼，向下走按理来说应该是地面层。
可琉璃川千代明明记得主楼梯那边都没有人守着，而这个偏僻的小楼梯却有人守着，这明显不正常。
蒂芙尼仍旧抱着刚才那个玻璃大碗，离开厨房前她都不忘让厨娘给她把碗里的水果沙拉加满。
她顺着琉璃川千代手指的方向看去，在注意到对方指的是什么之后，蒂芙尼的眼中闪过一丝异样，不过很快就被她藏了起来。
蒂芙尼像是有些困惑的模样用手指抵着脸：“我记得那里好像是通往地下室，但里面具体有啥我还真不知道呢。”
说着，蒂芙尼还眨了眨纯真的大眼睛看着琉璃川千代：“千代姐姐，你要下去看看吗？”
“说不定我可以让门口的骑士大叔放我们进去看看哦~”
琉璃川千代摇了摇头：“不用了，我初来乍到，还是不要到处乱闯的比较好。”
“那我们上楼吧，要是再不回去休息，妈妈又要来揪我耳朵了。”
说到这里，蒂芙尼还缩了缩脑袋，显然，她对自己母亲艾莎夫人是实实在在的有些怕。
“休息吗……”
一提起这个，琉璃川千代的脸色就泛起了一丝红晕。
休息那不就意味着她要去给那位枫叶伯爵暖床了。
而且等那个男人回来，恐怕就不止是暖床了……
但琉璃川千代十分清楚自己现在只能按照他安排的去做，于是她缓缓点了点头：“我们上楼吧。”
两人上楼，不同于蒂芙尼时不时一步跨两三节楼梯的跳脱，琉璃川千代走路永远都是一步一步的脚踏实地，显得很是淑女。
不过她的速度却一点都不比蒂芙尼慢，也不知道是如何做到的。
“骑士长，我们不是要去收拾哥布林吗，为什么还要准备攻城器械？”
此时，已经从城门换班回来的塔林姆一脸困惑的挠头。
难不成哥布林也会筑城了？
佛丁瞥了一眼塔林姆：“这是伯爵大人的交代，我也不知道为什么。”
他们此刻站在枫叶城堡门口，居高临下的看着夜幕下的枫叶城。
今晚的月色很亮，即使城内压根没有什么照明的路灯，凭借着骑士优异的视力依旧能看清大致的情况。
塔林姆点了点头：“好，那什么时候要，也是三十天内准备好吗？”
既然是伯爵大人的吩咐，那他就没话可讲了。
永远不能质疑自己效忠对象已经做出的决定，这是他们这些骑士的守则。
佛丁摇了摇头：“在四十五天内准备好就行了。”
塔林姆现在更困惑了，不是说三十天后就要出征吗？
怎么攻城器械反而要的更晚，难不成不是这次出征所需要用的？
但他没有继续问为什么，而是默默的记下了要求，准备明天天亮后去召集城里的那些工匠。
就在这时，叶海穿戴整齐走了出来。
两人赶忙迎了上去：“伯爵大人。”
content_en:
: "By the way...where does that downward passage lead to?"
After walking out of the kitchen with Tiffany, Rurigawa Chiyo stretched out her hand and pointed to a remote staircase with two heavy-armored knights guarding the door.
They are on the first floor now, and logically speaking, they should be on the ground floor if they go down.
But Rurigawa Chiyo clearly remembered that no one was guarding the main staircase, but there was someone guarding this remote small staircase. This was obviously abnormal.
Tiffany was still holding the big glass bowl just now, and before leaving the kitchen, she didn't forget to ask the cook to top up the fruit salad in the bowl.
She looked in the direction of Rurigawa Chiyo's finger. After noticing what the other party was pointing at, something strange flashed in Tiffany's eyes, but she quickly hid it.
Tiffany looked a little confused and put her finger on her face: "I remember that it seemed to lead to the basement, but I really don't know what's in it."
After saying that, Tiffany blinked her big innocent eyes and looked at Liulicawa Chiyo: "Sister Chiyo, do you want to go down and take a look?"
"Maybe I can ask the knight uncle at the door to let us in and have a look~"
Rurigawa Chiyo shook her head: "No need, I'm new here, so it's better not to wander around."
"Then let's go upstairs. If I don't go back to rest, my mother will come and pull my ears again."
At this point, Tiffany shrank her head. Obviously, she was really afraid of her mother, Mrs. Aisha.
"Rest?"
As soon as this was mentioned, Rurigawa Chiyo's face turned red.
Doesn't resting mean that she has to warm the bed of Earl Maple Leaf?
And when that man comes back, I'm afraid he will be doing more than just warming the bed...
But Rurigawa Chiyo knew very well that she could only do what he arranged now, so she nodded slowly: "Let's go upstairs."
The two of them went upstairs. Unlike Tiffany, who jumped up and down two or three stairs at a time, Rurigawa Chiyo always walked down to earth step by step, looking very ladylike.
But her speed is not slower than Tiffany at all, and she doesn't know how she does it.
…
"Knight Commander, aren't we going to deal with the goblins? Why do we need to prepare siege equipment?"
At this time, Talim, who had returned from his shift at the city gate, scratched his head in confusion.
Is it possible that goblins can also build cities?
Fording glanced at Talim: "This is the Earl's explanation, and I don't know why."
They were standing at the entrance of Maple Leaf Castle, looking down at Maple Leaf City under the night sky.
The moonlight is very bright tonight. Even if there are no street lights in the city, the knight can still see the general situation clearly with his excellent eyesight.
Talim nodded: "Okay, when will you want it? Will it be ready within thirty days?"
Since it was the Earl's order, he had nothing to say.
It is the code of these knights to never question the decision of their allegiance.
"No."
Fording shook his head: "Just prepare it within forty-five days."
Talim was even more confused now. Didn't he say that he would go on an expedition in thirty days?
Why are the siege equipment needed later? Could it be that they are not needed for this expedition?
But he did not continue to ask why, but silently wrote down the request and prepared to summon the craftsmen in the city after dawn tomorrow.
At this moment, Ye Hai dressed up and walked out.
The two people hurriedly greeted him: "Your Majesty the Earl."
"Yeah."
